error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
population_rule: population: accounts of /etc/passwd whose /etc/shadow field 2 starts with $; parsing as local-account-password-state-check-semantic-v2 in the same order (empty file, empty record, field count, account name, duplicate, missing shadow record are ERROR); fields 3-8 of a population record are empty or digits, otherwise ERROR shadow:invalid-number; /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow are regular files (lstat), st_nlink 1, owner root, no group or other write; their directory is a root directory without group or other write; otherwise ERROR
source_rule: fstec-configuration-2026 item 1.1 table 2 sets the maximum password age to 90 days; by user decisions 01.10-02.10.2026 (password aging segmentation map v6) the password age of existing accounts with a password hash is at most 90 days; this is a company policy check, not the PAM expiry decision; CHECK only
value_rule: VALUE is accounts=N;age_over=A;date_empty=B;date_zero=C;date_future=E with today = days since 1970-01-01 UTC by the system clock: field 3 empty counts date_empty, 0 date_zero, greater than today date_future, today minus field 3 greater than 90 age_over; PASS when all four are 0
